_note: Single source of product facts for the site, schema, llms.txt, lints and prompts. Public App Store data only. scripts/check-facts.mjs compares it with the live US listing; it may rewrite only rating.* and only when the 1-decimal value or rating.show flips (show = value >= 4.5 and count >= 20). A change in storeName or minIOS needs a human because copy depends on it. 2026-11-20 (app source, docs/app-knowledge/, evidence in seven-answers.md): minIOS 15.0 is the install floor only; wallpaperMinIOS/wallpaperMinIOSText (the wallpaper, the wallpaper picker and the Lock Screen widgets) must be named next to it (lint rule ios15-wallpaper; the --dist llms.txt check requires both). editions 11 (Arabic plus 10 translations) in appLanguages 10 (Arabic plus 9 more); one edition per ayah. The lint also fails: denying audio (the app has read-along recitation per ayah), a full-surah audio player, 'no tracking' / 'no analytics' / 'no data collected' / 'verse selections stay on your device' (Mixpanel and RevenueCat are in the app), a bare 'works offline' (say the Quran text works offline), themed packs, a dhikr or tasbih widget, Focus-mode install, pin or favourites, iPad/Mac/iCloud/large or circular widgets. storeUrl keeps the slug the repo CLAUDE.md documents; Apple 301s it to the current slug (quran-widget-quranwall) and keeps pt and ct (checked 2026-11-16). downloadsFloor/downloadsAsOf: a lower bound on total downloads from App Store Connect (a private count, confirmed by the ASO session), not in the public listing; the allowed download and user-count claims are all tied to downloadsFloor: "Downloaded <downloadsFloor> times", "<downloadsFloor> downloads" (rule social-proof-downloads), "Trusted by <downloadsFloor> believers", "Join <downloadsFloor> believers" and the stat "<downloadsFloor> Believers using QuranWall" (rule social-proof, scripts/lint-facts.mjs allowedProofStripped); a different number in any of them, and any other user or download count, is a FAIL. Karol confirmed on 2026-11-17 that the waitlist testimonials and the 92% stat are real waitlist responses and chose to keep 'Trusted by 1,000+ believers'. Raise the floor and the date together when the count grows.
